STEP 1 - Scene: A home-style lunch or dinner plate with roasted vegetables, tofu or tempeh pieces, mixed salad greens, and a creamy grain or pasta salad.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm². Food covers most of the plate.

STEP 3 - Items: roasted cauliflower florets; crispy fried tofu or tempeh cubes; roasted zucchini, squash, eggplant and pepper; mixed salad leaves; creamy grain or pasta salad with dressing.

STEP 4 - Area (% of vessel):
- Roasted cauliflower: 12%
- Crispy tofu/tempeh cubes: 8%
- Roasted vegetables (zucchini, squash, pepper, eggplant): 8%
- Mixed salad leaves: 25%
- Creamy grain salad: 12%
- Total food coverage ≈ 65%, which is consistent with a plate that is mostly covered.

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Cauliflower: 64 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 127 ml
- Tofu/tempeh: 42 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 64 ml
- Roasted vegetables: 42 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 64 ml
- Salad leaves: 133 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 400 ml
- Grain salad: 64 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 127 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (volume × bulk density):
- Cauliflower: 127 × 0.6 ≈ 77 g
- Tofu/tempeh: 64 × 0.9 ≈ 57 g
- Roasted vegetables: 64 × 0.6 ≈ 38 g
- Salad leaves: 400 × 0.15 ≈ 60 g
- Grain salad: 127 × 0.9 ≈ 115 g
- Total ≈ 347 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Cauliflower: 77 g × 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 19 kcal
- Tofu/tempeh: 57 g × 150 ≈ 86 kcal
- Roasted vegetables: 38 g × 35 ≈ 13 kcal
- Salad leaves: 60 g × 20 ≈ 12 kcal
- Grain salad: 115 g × 150 ≈ 172 kcal
- Total ≈ 302 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A plate about two-thirds covered, with a substantial creamy salad and fried tofu, plausibly holds roughly 300–350 g and 250–350 kcal. The estimate fits. Dressing and oil are not separately visible, so they are included within the grain salad and tofu values.
